ELEMENT_DOMINANT.GROWTH: Your dominant Growth energy gives you an unstoppable drive to start new things, but it can leave you restless.
ELEMENT_DOMINANT.SPARK: Your intense Spark energy makes you highly visible and magnetic, though it risks burning you out.
ELEMENT_DOMINANT.GROUND: Your heavy Ground energy makes you the reliable anchor for others, but you may carry too much weight.
ELEMENT_DOMINANT.EDGE: Your sharp Edge energy gives you surgical clarity, but you must be careful not to cut too deep.
ELEMENT_DOMINANT.FLOW: Your deep Flow energy grants you profound adaptability and wisdom, but you might struggle to commit.

ELEMENT_DEFICIENT.GROWTH: Your lack of Growth means you often struggle to start things without a clear push.
ELEMENT_DEFICIENT.SPARK: Your scarce Spark means you don't naturally perform enthusiasm, preferring quiet warmth.
ELEMENT_DEFICIENT.GROUND: Your missing Ground means you can feel unmoored, finding stability through movement.
ELEMENT_DEFICIENT.EDGE: Your lack of Edge means you naturally avoid conflict and soften your boundaries.
ELEMENT_DEFICIENT.FLOW: Your scarce Flow means you prefer to know exactly where you're going before you move.

GYEOKGUK.STABILIZER: With a Stabilizer structure, you thrive in building and maintaining systems.
GYEOKGUK.WARRIOR: With a Warrior structure, you are built to face conflict and break through obstacles.
GYEOKGUK.CUSTODIAN: With a Custodian structure, you find deep meaning in managing resources and protecting others.
GYEOKGUK.DEALMAKER: With a Dealmaker structure, you spot opportunities where others see noise.
GYEOKGUK.EXPRESSER: With an Expresser structure, you turn abstract ideas into tangible value.
GYEOKGUK.DISRUPTOR: With a Disruptor structure, you constantly question the status quo.
GYEOKGUK.MENTOR: With a Mentor structure, you find purpose in guiding others and sharing knowledge.
GYEOKGUK.INTUITIVE: With an Intuitive structure, your mind works laterally, seeing connections others miss.
GYEOKGUK.EDGE_WALKER: With an Edge Walker structure, you tread the line between order and chaos.
GYEOKGUK.COOPERATOR: With a Cooperator structure, you find strength in peer alliances.
GYEOKGUK.SELF_MADE: With a Self-Made structure, you rely on your own hard work above all else.

SINSAL.MAGNETIC_DRAW: Your Magnetic Draw means people notice you before you even speak.
SINSAL.RESTLESS_FEET: Your Restless Feet mean you are wired for movement and exploration.
SINSAL.SOLITARY_DEPTH: Your Solitary Depth gives you a rich inner world that few get to see.
SINSAL.ALLY_MAGNET: Your Ally Magnet means you naturally attract mentors and supporters.
SINSAL.SCHOLAR_MIND: Your Scholar Mind gives you a natural hunger for deep knowledge.
SINSAL.SHARP_EDGE: Your Sharp Edge means you have a competitive, unyielding drive.
SINSAL.COMMANDER: Your Commander trait makes you a natural leader with a strong moral compass.

RELATIONS.day_chong: You have an inner restlessness that craves constant change. You thrive when you're moving, exploring, or challenging the status quo. In relationships, you need space and novelty to stay engaged.
RELATIONS.has_chong: Your life is driven by unpredictable changes and challenges. It might feel exhausting at times, but this is exactly what makes you highly adaptable, resilient, and uniquely creative.

SPECIAL_CONDITIONS.RESTLESS_FEET: You are a born 'wanderer'. You gain energy and grow through new experiences, travel, or career shifts. Being stuck in a rigid routine is your worst nightmare.
SPECIAL_CONDITIONS.seven_killings: You possess strong 'Boss' energy. You excel at taking control, strategizing, and leading the pack. You actually get stronger under pressure and crisis.
